user.title: Connect to Etsy Shop Manager
user.description: Enter the address of your Etsy Shop Manager service and an API key created in the app under Admin > API keys.

data_description.url: The address you open the app at, e.g. https://etsy.example.lan
data_description.api_key: Starts with esm_. It is shown once, when the key is created.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only if the app uses a certificate Home Assistant doesn't trust (e.g. a self-signed one).

reauth_confirm.title: New API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: {url} rejected the API key (it may have been revoked). Create a new key in the app under Admin > API keys.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the service at that address.

abort.already_configured: This service is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks the service for open orders (5-3600). The service checks Etsy on its own schedule, set in the app under Admin > Settings.
